name: Now playing
what: A song card: a vinyl disc with the cover spins, the title (scrolling when long) and artist under it, a progress bar and the time counting, play controls - everything pulsing on the beat; or a visualizer whose bars jump on every beat.

learned_from.what: the spinning record with its cover, the scrolling title, the progress bar and controls
violet bars pulsing in the middle, Now playing, the song name

motion: parts in 16 f, 3 f apart; the disc spins 33 rpm and pulses 1.025 on each beat (bpm); bars jump 3 f up and fall to the next beat
